player_prompt.intro:
Kai dan wasa {player_id} ka na wasa da wasan Dambe a matsayin {color}.
Yi motsi ka a salon wasan Chess [fileRank fileRank], misali '[b2c3]' (harafin safu a–h, adadin safu 0–7).
Ka'idoji na asali:
  • Yi motsi a diagonal zuwa gaba da 1 idan kowa.
  • Kama ta hawa kan abokin wasa.
  • Dan wasa ya zama Sarki idan ya kai karshen gefe guda.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Babu salon motsi da aka yarda da shi. Yi amfani da [a1b2], misali [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Red walaa kujeji lutti. Black ɗon heɓa!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Black wala kujeji lutti. Red hocci!
